errors.base: Could not read your config with noctalia config export: {error}
errors.invalid: nix-instantiate rejected the generated file, nothing was written: {error}
errors.no_cli: The noctalia command is not on PATH, so the applied config cannot be compared.
errors.no_record: {path} already exists, but this plugin has no record of what is in it, so an export could drop values. Use "Import current config" in the panel first, or the IPC event reset to start from the GUI settings alone.
errors.no_target: No target file is set in the plugin settings.

cleanup_done_body.one: 1 applied value removed from settings.toml. Backup: {backup}
cleanup_done_body.other: {count} applied values removed from settings.toml. Backup: {backup}

notify.cleanup_none_body: None of the GUI values are in your config yet. Rebuild/switch first.

done_body.one: 1 setting written to {path}. Rebuild/switch your configuration to apply it.
done_body.other: {count} settings written to {path}. Rebuild/switch your configuration to apply them.

notify.remind_export_body: You changed settings in the GUI that are not in your Nix file yet. Click the Export to Nix tile to export them.
notify.remind_rebuild_body: Your Nix file has settings your system does not use yet. Rebuild/switch your configuration to apply them.

panel.cleanup_button: I have rebuilt: clean up settings.toml
panel.cleanup_intro: Removes GUI values from settings.toml that your rebuilt config now sets to the same value. Values your config does not have yet are kept.
panel.cleanup_none: None of the GUI values are in your config yet. Rebuild/switch first.

cleanup_ready.one: 1 value is now provided by your config.
cleanup_ready.other: {count} values are now provided by your config.

export_current.one: 1 setting in the Nix file, up to date.
export_current.other: {count} settings in the Nix file, up to date.

export_pending.one: 1 setting, the GUI changed since the last export.
export_pending.other: {count} settings, the GUI changed since the last export.

panel.import_tooltip: Adds your whole current Noctalia config (without the GUI layer) to the Nix file, so the file can replace your own config. Needed once.
panel.rebuild_body: Include the file in your configuration and run nixos-rebuild switch or home-manager switch yourself. This plugin never builds or switches.
panel.title: Settings to Nix

auto_export.description: Export automatically whenever a setting is changed in the GUI. Off: export with the control-center tile or IPC.
auto_export.label: Export automatically

exclude.description: Dotted paths left out of the export; * matches one level. The defaults are runtime data that changes with every wallpaper switch.
exclude.label: Excluded paths

notify.description: Show a notification after a manual export. Errors are always shown.
notify.label: Notifications

remind_export_hours.description: Notify once when GUI changes have not been exported for this long. 0 turns it off; not used with automatic export.
remind_export_hours.label: Remind to export after (hours)

remind_rebuild_days.description: Notify once when exported settings are still not in your built config this many days after the export. 0 turns it off.
remind_rebuild_days.label: Remind to rebuild after (days)

target_path.description: Nix file the GUI settings are written to (overwritten on every export). With flakes, point this inside your config repository.
target_path.label: Target Nix file

validate.description: Check the generated file with nix-instantiate --parse before replacing the target (skipped when nix-instantiate is not on PATH).
validate.label: Validate with nix-instantiate
